notes.title: 【v1.24.31 Update】Bug Fixes & Optimizations
notes.content: [p]Greetings Swordsmen![/p][p]We’ve just released another update packed with key fixes and improvements. Here’s what’s new in v1.24.31:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Zhenwu's Sword Intent Lv.5[/b]: Fixed an issue where this effect did not apply correctly to [i]Drifting Cloud Tai Chi[/i] and [i]Cloudform Tai Chi[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Baidi Sword Spirit Lv.5[/b]: Fixed a bug where the counter effect only triggered Lv.1 [i]Teal Water Swordplay[/i]. It will now always trigger the Lv.10 version regardless of the skill’s current level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolute Stoneform Lv.7[/b]: Fixed an issue where the [i]Authenticity Unveiled[/i] effect incorrectly reduced the user’s own defense.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Repelling Staff Technique Lv.7[/b]: Corrected text to reflect actual values (10% bonus damage, 5% damage reduction). This was a text fix only — skill effects remain unchanged.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Encompassing Saberplay Lv.10[/b]: Fixed an issue where bonus damage did not apply properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Siege Piercer Spearplay Lv.5[/b]: Fixed an issue where bonus damage did not apply properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dharma Cave (Hard Mode, 3rd Battle)[/b]: Fixed an issue where Yuan Hui's Phantom did not have equipment equipped.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Traditional Chinese Language Issue[/b]: Fixed a bug where DLC mounts became unavailable after switching to Traditional Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camelbell Hill Cutscenes[/b]: Fixed a visual bug with background sky when casting [i]Hundred Jade Dragon Forms, Crows' Cawing[/i], or [i]Celestial Fairy Swordplay[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected several typos throughout the game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚙️ Optimizations[/h2][list][*][p]Updated descriptions for certain skills that grant proficiency to better reflect the actual number of points received.[/p][/*][*][p]Ouyang Xiong from Mingjian Manor will now sell [i]winterspring[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Added six martial arts manuals (taught by Jiang Yinfeng) to [b]Wang Shitou[/b] on the second We’re excited to finally share what’s coming next in Wandering Sword! After much preparation, our long-awaited DLC is almost here.

On June 19, we’ll be releasing two DLCs:

[b]Secrets of the Eastern Sea[/b] –[b] priced at $6.99, with a 15% launch discount![/b]

[b]Wandering Sword - Hero's Adventure Collaboration DLC[/b] – a free crossover DLC with The Hero's Journey, available for all players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/609c47e6aea26fc53b68cb85276c1b13ae6e8d0b.png[/img]
[h3]Sailing into the Eastern Sea[/h3]
In Secrets of the Eastern Sea, you’ll set sail on a brand-new adventure, following an invitation from the mysterious Pearl of the Fairy Isles. Explore distant islands shrouded in mist and uncover secrets hidden beyond the waves.

Unlock new outfits for Shangguan Hong and Sima Ling, and meet two new "bouncy" mounts to accompany you on your journey!

You’ll also gain access to Nameless Island, a peaceful hideaway where you can build your own sanctuary. Manage daily affairs, trade with traveling merchants, and test your tactical skills in an open arena with fully customizable formations.

The world is vast, the sea is boundless—and the martial world is both a beginning and an end.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/456c6284266b60ef0c5da74912c55690b2eed0ef.jpg[/img]
[h3]Blood Oaths and Buried Truths[/h3]
In Wandering Sword - Hero's Adventure Collaboration DLC, uncover two untold stories from the past. As old secrets resurface and fateful encounters unfold, new pages are written into the legends of the martial world.

You’ll also unlock a new outfit for Lü Xian'er as part of this story-driven DLC.


[h3]The Mirage Tower Challenge[/h3]

Starting from your second playthrough, the mysterious Mirage Tower will become available. Ascend floor by floor to challenge martial arts legends and prove your strength to the masters of the land.

We’re also rolling out a visual update to the Jade Dragon Spear, giving it a sleeker and more striking combat appearance.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876890/Wandering_Sword/

notes.content:

After six months of hard work, we’re excited to announce that the Echoes of Ash and Dust update for Wandering Sword is now live!

[previewyoutube=itLC25_mH3o;full][/previewyoutube]
This major update brings new branching storylines, a thrilling conclusion to the main story, Steam achievements, expanded difficulty options, a new inheritance system, and much more. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876890/Wandering_Sword/

If you’re using mods, be aware that this update may cause compatibility issues, potentially preventing the game from launching or causing errors. To resolve this, we recommend uninstalling any mods, verifying the integrity of the game files, and then restarting.

[h3]Save Data Compatibility[/h3]
You can continue your journey from existing save files. For the best experience with the new storylines, we recommend using save files from the Main Quest: Return to Wudang for the best story experience.

[url=https://coconutisland.feishu.cn/docx/MKUfdcww8opQNgxwrcScKoEGneW?from=from_copylink ]The Echoes of Ash and Dust User Save File Guide[/url]

The young master of the TianJian Sect, Xiao Hanguang, has emerged from seclusion and issued a challenge to the Shaolin Temple. Meanwhile, rumors about his connections to the Tianji Palace are swirling. But on the day of the duel, an unexpected event shakes Shaolin to its core... What choices will Yuwen Yi, caught in the middle of this storm, make? What is the fate of the martial world? What does it truly mean to be a hero? The answers await in this new chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/3b916595c2eb63686bb00a03ea4f39eca3489c7c.jpg[/img]
[*] Additional Features: Convert excess meridian points, access a battlefield surrender option, and take on the Five Elements Challenge, where you’ll face tougher opponents for rarer rewards—or opt for safer, easier battles. The choice is yours!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/24ccaf7b178697efd345a77f4762be5e34284828.png[/img]

As a thank-you for your incredible support, we’ve prepared a special anniversary gift! After the update, head to Hero Jiang’s home and open the treasure chest located to the left of his entrance to claim your reward. The chest will remain there, waiting for you to claim it whenever you’re ready.

[h2]Back to the Dawn - A Quirky Prison Survival RPG [/h2]
[previewyoutube=4X61WNU4hSU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]About The Game[/h2]
Back to the Dawn provides an engrossing role-playing journey that combines vibrant pixel art with the suspense and thrills of prison life. Within the ominous walls of a maximum-security prison, play as a wrongfully imprisoned journalist entangled in a shadowy conspiracy. Interact with over 40 diverse animal inmates, forge unpredictable alliances or deep rivalries and hone essential skills for a daring escape. Immerse yourself in a sprawling adventure that stretches beyond 20 hours of gameplay, where cunning strategy and tactical acumen are the keys to orchestrating your breakout and unraveling the truth.

[h2]Expansive RPG Storylines[/h2]
In "Wandering Sword", you've experienced the option to choose from a myriad of weapons and martial arts techniques tailored to your preference. If you've enjoyed the freedom to pursue the main storyline or explore enriching side quests, Back to the Dawn will cater to your taste for variability as well. Dive deep into the complexities of the prison world while adopting diverse play styles, from brawling to cunning thievery.

[h2]Strategic Turn-Based Brawls[/h2]
The turn-based battles in Wandering Sword have provided a depth of strategy that requires forethought and precision. If you've loved this tactical challenge of calculated maneuvers, Back to the Dawn offers a similar strategic depth. Experience meticulously planned turn-based combat and feel the tension of every prison standoff or brawl with inmates!

[h2]Deepening Bonds and Forging Alliances[/h2]
Wandering Sword places a strong emphasis on relationships, from building connections with realistic NPCs to recruiting martial artists with unique abilities and backstories. If these intricate dynamics have resonated with you, Back to the Dawn offers an equally engrossing narrative of relationship-building. Engage with over 40 distinct animal inmates, and forge deep alliances that will influence your survival and eventual outcome. 

[h2]Your Choice, Your Story[/h2]
In Wandering Sword, the choices you make through the game will lead to a tapestry of different outcomes, offering a unique adventure with each playthrough. With over 20 hours of gripping gameplay, every decision you make weaves a unique story, culminating in a variety of possible endings.

notes.title: Our First Major Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings Swordsmen! ⚔️

We hope your Wandering Sword adventure has been filled with thrilling duels and epic tales. As you continue to hone your skills, make alliances, and journey towards becoming a legendary Wuxia master, we're thrilled to share that our first major game update has now been rolled out! Without further delay, let’s delve into the enhancements and tweaks we've introduced.

[h2]Font Size & Resolution Optimizations [/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the game to allow players to resize the window in windowed mode in a 16:9 ratio
[*] Added a new game resolution setting of 1280 x 720
[*] Adjusted the 4K resolution to 3840 x 2160
[*] Introduced Large, Medium, and Small font size options for dialogues[/list][i]Note: We've yet to add other font size options such as task descriptions, but we will get to it soon![/i]

[h2]Feature Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial for switching combat modes after Jiang Yin Feng joined the party
[*] Optimized party members’ strength in Mount Wanzi mission and reduced the number of enemies
[*] Introduced a new medicinal item drop after defeating Wei Huo, ensuring players could immediately build rapport with him
[*] Simplified the conditions for Wei Huo to leave the party after completing his initial quests
[*] Optimized Jiang Yin Feng's combat movement animations
[*] Relocated the Fisherman in Wutong Village to prevent simultaneous triggering of dialogue and fishing
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the “Skyline Battle” side quest, including improved health regeneration after battles
[*] Addition of prompts for initiating certain side quests
[*] Optimized text on the loading screen regarding keyboard and mouse battlefield controls[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing ESC during dialogues would unintentionally close both dialogue and options
[*] Fixed an issue during the first battle tutorial with Master Qingxu that could prevent players from progressing ahead
[*] Fixed a display issue during a cutscene animation between Mowen & Mo Qi
[*] Resolved issues related to the interactions and boundaries within certain areas of the world map
[*] Fixed the backdrop setting of certain sparring battles to match the location
[*] Fixed the display animation of enemies and teammates during certain battles
[*] Updated and improved visual effects for certain special skill techniques
[*] Fixed a description error in the "Seeking Help from All Quarters" side quest
[*] Fixed the excessive auto-saves before the “Skyline Battle” side quest[/list]
[h2]Addressing Known Concerns[/h2]
In addition, there are also some known issues that we would like to address: 

[h3]Controller Mapping[/h3]
We've been informed that controller support is bugged for certain users, which is making the game unplayable for them. Issues such as swapped button inputs, and non-responsive joysticks have been reported. 

We're planning to enable accurate key mapping even if you don't disable certain settings in the Steam client, and also introduce various controller modes for everyone to choose from. As this requires time for us to design and test, please bear with us while we work on it - we will keep everyone updated!

In the meantime, if you are facing any controller button mapping issues, please try these workarounds to see if it solves the issue!
[i]Just in case, please ensure to keep a save file backup before trying these workarounds.
[/i]
[u]Workaround 1: Adjusting External Gamepad Settings[/u]

- Navigate to [b]Steam Settings>Controller>External Gamepad Settings[/b]
- Uncheck the options highlighted in the yellow box shown in the image below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/8b88e5b8b45353efe18152ba267f43f2120d61f7.png[/img]
- Once done, restart the game to implement the changes.

[u]Workaround 2: Disabling Steam Input for Specific Game[/u]

- Right-click on "Wandering Sword" in your Steam Library.
- Navigate to [b]Properties > Controller[/b]
- Under "Override for Wandering Sword", set it to "Disable Steam Input".
- Then, go to [b]Steam Settings > Controller > External Gamepad Settings[/b]
- Check the option: "Enable Steam Input for Xbox Controllers".
- Finally, relaunch the game.

[i]A big thank you to Zleven for sharing this workaround with the community![/i]

[u]Workaround 3: Installing Xbox Extended Feature Support Driver[/u]

- Head over to [b]Steam Settings > Controller > External Gamepad Settings > Xbox Extended Feature Support Driver.[/b]
- Install the driver.
- After the installation is complete, reboot your PC and relaunch the game.

[i]A big thank you to CoffeeStainedShirt for sharing this workaround with the community![/i]

Whether these workarounds were effective for you or not, your experience would help us as we aim to refine the controller modes, so please share with us how it went, and the controller you are using on this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1876890/discussions/0/7008219766198145362/]discussion thread[/url]! 

[h3]Adjusting Character Orientation On The Battlefield[/h3]
We've heard your feedback regarding character orientation during battle. We are actively working to enhance this, starting with allowing characters to automatically face enemies upon moving. Given the complexity and time required to craft detailed pixel art for different orientations, we're mapping out the most feasible solution to strike a balance and ensure the best experience for everyone.

We acknowledge the feedback regarding character direction after movement. We're actively working to enhance this, starting with an automatic face-off towards enemies post-attack. For those seeking more granular control, we understand the desire. Given the complexity, including creating pixel art for all possible orientations, we're mapping out the most feasible solution. Balance is our guiding principle, and we want to ensure the best experience for everyone.

[h3]Auto-Battle Feature & Battle Speed-Up Option[/h3]
We are glad to share that an auto-battle mode is in our future plans! Concurrently, we're coordinating with our technical team regarding an option to speed up battles. Our focus is on delivering these improvements without compromising gameplay stability, and we'll keep everyone updated on this.

[h3]NPCs Sparring Reward System[/h3]
As your Affinity with an NPC rises, the likelihood of receiving rewards when you spar with them will increase as well. When you have reached 70 Affinity, you are guaranteed to be rewarded with an item. However, we recognize that our current tutorial may not convey this effectively, and we're in the process of optimizing this aspect for clarity and better understanding.

We genuinely appreciate the time you've taken to share your experiences and feedback with us, as is crucial in helping us refine Wandering Sword every step of the way. Please continue to share with us your feedback, suggestions or any issues either here on Steam or through our Discord channel!

If you've enjoyed our recent updates and feel we've addressed your concerns, we kindly ask that you consider updating your review, especially if you previously left us a negative one. Your positive feedback is a tremendous encouragement and motivates us to continually improve. Thank you for your support!

But wait - before we end this article, we have a special treat to share. One of our players has beautifully reimagined our battle BGM through this violin cover! It's amazing to see our game music inspire such creativity. Do give it a listen and immerse yourself in the soulful strings that capture the essence of our battles!

[previewyoutube=zJGSu3JpFoc;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you once again for your unwavering support. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep your swords sharp! ⚔️

notes.title: Introducing Wandering Sword’s Diverse Martial Arts Sects!
notes.content:
Greetings Swordsmen!

In this article, we would like to introduce you to the diverse martial arts sects that form the backbone of Wandering Sword's rich storyline. Amongst the numerous sects each with its own unique charm, we will be focusing on four main sects today: Wudang Sect, Shaolin Monastery, Xuanhuo Cult, and Mingjian Manor. Get ready to set foot on a fascinating journey as you discover the history behind these sects! 

[h2]Wudang Sect
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/9e3f95140dae3aa9ba2bac305354a887b12373ba.gif[/img]
Firstly, we invite you to the serene mountain peaks of Wudang, a sect revered for its esteemed reputation in the martial arts world. Wudang Sect embodies the principles of Tai Chi and Yin Yang in their martial arts, crafting an aura of tranquility amidst strength. Such principles are reflected in their swordplay techniques, which strike a perfect balance of grace and power. As you embark on your martial arts adventure in Wandering Sword, the opportunity to ascend and lead this prestigious sect might just be around the corner!

[h2]Shaolin Monastery
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/2ed7708cb0296da4bdcc8a14aecff20d090c3d36.gif[/img]
Next, we embark on a journey to the historical and influential Shaolin Monastery. As the leading institution of orthodox martial arts schools, Shaolin carries a profound history that spans a thousand years. The distinctive skills of Shaolin lie in their potent hand-to-hand combat and polearm techniques, making it the undisputed "North Star" of the martial arts world. As you venture deeper in your journey, mastering these techniques could lend you the strength of a thousand-year-old lineage, solid as the mountains and continuous as the rivers.

[h2]Xuanhuo Cult 
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/e6552f73ee6c6da9ea96bc3395e79b1e33e78ab5.gif[/img]
Next, we venture beyond the frontier, delving into the mysterious Xuanhuo Cult. Known for its unrivaled sabreplay techniques and unconventional practices, Xuanhuo Cult has earned the label of a "demonic sect" by the Central Plains martial arts community. Despite their controversial reputation, Xuanhuo Cult provides a challenging path for those who aren't afraid to diverge from tradition. Here lies the opportunity to master the unique sabreplay techniques that have marked them as such an infamous presence in the world of Wandering Sword.

[h2]Mingjian Manor
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/a36114d458365e7a4340367cbd2664d99923b3e6.gif[/img]
Finally, we arrive at the esteemed Mingjian Manor, celebrated far and wide for their unparalleled swordsmanship and legendary sword forging techniques.  Every legendary sword weapon that echoes in the tales of Wandering Sword has been crafted by the masters of this sect. Wielding a sword from Mingsword Manor opens up the exciting possibility of mastering these revered techniques, intertwining your path with the timeless art of swordplay that the sect is renowned for.

Throughout your journey across the lands in Wandering Sword, you’ll engage with these distinct sects, allowing you to master their unique weapons and skills. But the journey doesn’t end here. Beyond these four main sects, a wealth of other sects awaits your discovery, each with its own martial arts technique, captivating storyline and intriguing interactions!

notes.title: Wandering Sword - Introducing The Main Characters!
notes.content:
Greetings Swordsmen! 

In this post, we would like to introduce you to the main characters from Wandering Sword, each with their own unique personalities, backgrounds, and martial arts abilities. Prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey alongside these captivating characters and witness their stories unfold!

[h2]Yuwen Yi[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/5ed4d4c7060fae57702cbe1d1262e576924eb2f1.gif[/img]

First up is Yuwen Yi, our optimistic, cheerful, and righteous protagonist, reminiscent of the legendary Guo Jing from Jinyong’s epic novel - Legends of the Condor Heroes. Hailing from Liao City in the Outer Lands, Yuwen Yi has always been known for his unwavering moral compass. Tragedy struck when he and his friends were poisoned during a battle between rival sects. Only Yuwen Yi survived, thanks to the timely intervention of Master Qingxu, the leader of Wudang Sect.

Determined to protect the ones he loves, Yuwen Yi's story revolves around his transformation from an ordinary peasant to a skilled Wuxia master. With multiple endings to discover, such as exploring the world alongside your trusted companions, facing epic battles together, or ascending to lead the prestigious Wudang Sect, every choice you make will shape Yuwen's story. As the only playable character capable of mastering all weapons, the possibilities are endless and the excitement never ends. Experience the thrill of forging your own destiny in Wandering Sword as you guide Yuwen Yi on his journey!

[h2]Jiang Yinfeng[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/1521c48a01736599bd51ad6b07eb74136a7e7341.gif[/img]

Next we have Master Jiang Yinfeng, a complex man who carries a strong sense of justice who plays a supporting role in the game. As the direct lineal disciple of Wudang's late sect leader, Master Jiang was once a revered figure in the martial arts world. However, due to some unknown reasons, he mysteriously left the sect, choosing a life of seclusion with his daughter, Jiang Xiaotong.

Master Jiang is a master swordsman, and his years of intense training show in his swift and elegant moves. As you progress through the game, you'll peel back the layers of his intriguing backstory, uncovering the reasons behind his departure.

[h2]Girl in Red[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/ab333fb95f54a8e4e745f5fab714b9313834361f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Our Inspirations Behind Wandering Sword!
notes.content:
Greetings Swordsmen!

In this post, we would like to share with you how Wandering Sword - a wuxia based RPG that we've been pouring our hearts and souls into for the past 3 years - came about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/9cb3349fee60579bed8469f928f9fec2ce4a0978.png[/img]
[i]“Wuxia” (Chinese characters)[/i]

For those who may not be familiar, the word 'wuxia' is actually 2 characters in Chinese. 'Wu' means martial arts, and 'Xia' means chivalry. Put together, it means using martial arts to perform acts of chivalries to protect the weak. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/f951e24ad48474eae599167e5e635e681a5aa8b9.png[/img]
[i]Wuxia games: Heroes of Jin Yong (left), Xiao Ao Jiang Hu (right)[/i]

Our love for wuxia stories began decades ago, when we first played iconic wuxia games like Heroes of Jin Yong and Xiao Ao Jiang Hu. We were instantly hooked, and spent countless hours immersed in these captivating worlds filled with martial arts, romance, and honor.

Decades later, when we set out to develop our own game, we knew without a doubt that it had to be a wuxia game. It was our desire to bring back the magic of these beloved games into the world, and create a game that would transport players into a world of martial arts and adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/33892a5cef6bfeba0e27ecb8104459ca9f3fe721.png[/img]

With this in mind, we set out to create Wandering Sword - a game that would pay tribute to the legendary writer Jin Yong and his iconic wuxia novels. We wanted to capture the essence of what made these stories so captivating, while also offering a fresh take on the genre.

To achieve this, we spent countless hours brainstorming, researching, and prototyping. We looked at other successful wuxia games and drew inspiration from their mechanics, storytelling, and art styles. But we also wanted to add our own unique twist to the formula.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/57247d126e31201ae17e0923992a8fdd553b6a02.gif[/img]

One of the things that sets Wandering Sword apart from other wuxia games is its pixel art style. While many modern games strive for hyper-realistic graphics, we felt that the pixel art style was the perfect fit for our game. It reminded us of the classic games we loved so much, and it allowed us to create a vibrant and colorful world that was filled with character and personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/53ef956f0e5549151f5a4a0b43bd9c41a6b145f9.gif[/img]

Another key aspect of Wandering Sword is its combat system. We wanted to create a system that was both engaging and accessible, and that could appeal to both casual and hardcore gamers. After many iterations and prototypes, we finally settled on a hybrid system that combines real-time and turn-based elements. This allows players to choose between strategizing and planning their moves, or a play style that keeps  the pace of the game moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/242ecacf3266ac1d9a3677f4879dc4be33301bb4.png[/img]

But Wandering Sword is more than just a game about martial arts and combat. It's also a game about friendship, romance, and honor. In the game, players will meet a wide range of characters, each with their own unique personalities and motivations. Some will become friends, others will become rivals, and some may even become love interests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/56b7d18ea90959da73408036dfd579c6a3de7c55.gif[/img]
[i]Encounter a cast of colorful characters in Wandering Sword![/i]

And of course, no wuxia game would be complete without a gripping story. The story of Wandering Sword follows an ordinary man who is thrust into the world of martial arts and must navigate a treacherous web of alliances, feuds, and betrayals. Along the way, he will encounter a cast of colorful characters, each with their own motivations and secrets. The story follows a typical Jin Yong'ish formula, but we've added our own twists and surprises along the way.

Our goal with Wandering Sword is to create a game that captures the spirit and essence of wuxia, while also offering a fresh take on the genre. We want to transport players into a world filled with adventure, mystery, and romance, and give them the chance to become a martial arts legend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/2ee88c77281c1d7aeb7b12603dfe14820cfa6e4c.png[/img]

We're incredibly excited to share Wandering Sword with you, and we can't wait for you
to experience everything the game has to offer. From the sprawling landscapes and vibrant characters, to the pulse-pounding combat and gripping storyline, Wandering Sword is a game that we believe will captivate players from beginning to end.

Ultimately, our goal with Wandering Sword is to create a game that is both fun and meaningful. We believe that games can be a powerful tool for storytelling and self-expression, and we want to create a game that inspires players to discover their own inner hero.

We hope you're as excited about Wandering Sword as we are, and we can't wait to share more about the game in the coming months. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to embark on an epic adventure through ancient China!

The recovery speed of the action bar is related to the character's "Qi Gathering Speed" stat—The higher the value, the faster the character takes action. If you want to speed up the battle, and you already have some party members or are very familiar with the battle system, you can switch to "Real-Time battle mode" in "Settings". This will make the pace of the battle much faster.

[h3]Question: Compared with many other Wuxia games in recent years, is there any reason why Wandering Sword is much more conservative?[/h3]
At Swordsman Studio, we're passionate about Wuxia games, having grown up playing them ourselves.  As the first game of the studio, we hope to create a Wuxia game that can deliver a nostalgic yet modern experience. This way, both old and new players can revisit the classic Wuxia genre and relive or experience Wuxia for the first time.

[h3]Question: Will there be random events or quests on the World Map for the players to freely explore?[/h3]
There are NPCs wandering around on the World Map, but currently the game does not support random events. As mentioned before, Wandering Sword focuses more on its storytelling, supplemented by battles, meridians and other systems to enrich the gameplay.
However, even though you can only invite certain NPCs to your party (in the demo), you can give gifts to all NPCs to develop friendships and unlock more interactions with them. There are a variety of weapons and martial arts in the game, plus multiple endings of the main story and the side quests according to your choice. There is a certain degree of freedom in Wandering Sword for players to develop their own playstyle. 
We have already seen many players coming up with innovative ways to play the game that we never would have imagined. We are looking forward to see more unique playstyles in the future!

[h3]Question: Bandits and wild boars are too difficult to defeat![/h3]
The difficulty level of the demo version has not been fully refined. We will work on improving the balance in the game to create a smoother difficulty curve in the future.
If you're struggling with the bandit battles, you can recruit Bai Jin from the entrance of Luo Village to fight by your side, or head to Pingkang City to complete some side quests and upgrade your equipment to increase your character's strength.
The Wild Boar Woods is designed to be the most challenging area in the demo, so it's advisable to be well-prepared before attempting it.

[h3]Question: Do invitable characters affect the storyline?[/h3]
The overall storyline of the game is developed around the perspective of the main character Yuwen Yi, and some important characters that will join as teammates at some points (such as the Girl in Red in the demo). These "inevitable teammates" will promote the development of the story and are closely related to the main story.
As for other characters, such as Wei Huo from Wutong Village, who will not play a decisive role in the main story, they are currently designed to have their own side quests. This allows players to explore and discover new experiences, rather than feeling obligated to invite characters they may not be as interested in just to reach certain story endings.

[h3]Question: When will the game be released?[/h3]
We plan to release the game within 2023, but a specific date has not yet been decided. The demo playtest has provided us with valuable feedback and insights, and we would want to take the time to include and follow up with them on our development plans. We will keep you updated with the latest information as soon as it becomes available.

[h3]Question: Does the game support gamepad? Will there be a console version?[/h3]
The demo version does not support gamepad for now, but it will when it's officially released in the future.
There will be a console version in the future, and we will work on it after completing the PC version.

[h3]Question: What screen resolutions does the game support?[/h3]
The current demo does not support resolution adjustment. Currently, the game defaults to full screen and adapts to 16:9 screen. For non-16:9 aspect ratio, there will be black edges around it.

[h3]Question: How to switch the game to windowed mode?[/h3]
You can press Alt+Enter in the game to switch to windowed mode.

[h3]Question: We can't use consumables in battle, can we?[/h3]
No, you can't. To restore HP, you can cast "Compose" or healing cultivation methods that you will learn as you progress through the demo.

[h3]Question: Can the saved progress in the demo be used in the official version?[/h3]
We are working on incorporating optimizations and new systems which might include the storyline in the demo. As we want to ensure that players get to fully experience these new optimizations, we regret to inform that progress made in the demo version will not be transferred to the official release.

We appreciate all the feedback we have received regarding issues such as the annoyance of the red dot indicating a new item, small UI text, issues with collecting items, and trees obstructing the view. We have noted all of these suggestions and are actively working on ways to improve them for the official release of Wandering Sword. Thank you for taking the time to provide us with your valuable feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/6237bf198dcf36c2c525bbd45bb10007c4769947.jpg[/img]
[h2]An Immersive Pixel Art Adventure Awaits You[/h2]
Step into the captivating lively open world and experience the beauty of Wandering Sword. Explore bustling towns, serene rivers, picturesque forest, and breathtaking landscapes, all rendered in stunning HD-2D pixel graphics that bring the world of Wandering Sword to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/a95ccb224f0853453c1c4fad2daac91dcb7502e4.png[/img]
[h2]Unleash The Wuxia Master Within You[/h2]
As you traverse the lands, you will come across numerous martial arts schools, each boasting its own unique techniques and weapon specialization. With the freedom to choose between different weapon classes, you can hone your skills under the guidance of the masters and become a true Wuxia master yourself. Enhance your character's stats and abilities by cultivating your energy through the meridian system and become an expert of both the external and internal energy forms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/8c23ed63bb5de0a914bd8b28bf684e1118c5eb93.png[/img]

[/h2]Wandering Sword offers a unique battle mechanic that allows players to switch between real-time or turn-based combat. Those who prefer a more traditional RPG experience can choose turn-based mode, where they can strategize and plan their moves, while those who crave fast-paced action can select real-time mode and execute attacks as quickly as possible. Both modes offer unique challenges and provide an engaging combat experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/5e993140161503250e262b151e9243946f926ea3.jpg[/img]
[h2]Forging Friendships, Forming Alliances[/h2]
In your conquest to be a Wuxia master, you will meet skilled martial artists from different schools and walks of life. Foster bonds and build friendships with them through giving gifts based on their preferences and engaging in friendly sparring matches. You can even invite some of them to join you as allies and embark on an epic adventure together!

We can't wait for you to try out this demo and hear your feedback - good or bad. It would help you get a glimpse of our vision and help us understand what you like or dislike about Wandering Sword. notes.title: Wandering Sword - A Progress Update + Upcoming Demo!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Swordsmen![/b]

Happy 2023!

How are you? We've been hard at work but thought that it would be appropriate at this point to give you an update on what we've been up to and what you can expect in the coming months ahead! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/f777121c3aae96fb882f3b80b5d40703d53f1c55.png[/img]

So, first of all, some of you will know that there will be a Steam Next Fest coming in February 2023. We are pleased to announce that we will be taking this opportunity to [b]launch a demo of Wandering Sword for the very first time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/c7972b1ae7b2dbbb4b73c15bb7601f67d8f288e2.gif[/img]

To make sure we give you a good experience and idea of what Wandering Sword offers, we have been working on making sure that the demo is jam-packed with a good amount of content. You will be able to play through the first Act and go through a series of battles and quests. You will get a good idea of the gameplay, graphics, battle system, music and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/38b3fc2498284c2c4c98eb4608a5e9f9e8a24283.png[/img]

There's a side quest that we are developing too that we can't wait to show you. Hint - it involves fishing! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/f42dce262ef8953571caeeacd55488b881e6781f.gif[/img]

As game developers we have to deal with a ton of challenges during development. Bugs are just one of them. There are difficult decisions we have to make all the time - such as deciding what kinds of martial arts to include in the game and how to best animate and present them, how to design the UI such that it gives gamers a better experience, how to make the battle system intuitive and fun, how to ensure that the storyline is engaging, what characters to put into the game, what kinds of sound effects and soundtracks to uplift the gameplay and more!

But honestly, it's all great fun for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/863592f487bd0919dd2fd898fb62ec6a53566d8f.png[/img]

We have also been working on a new Wandering Sword logo, and are pleased to show it to you with the in-game title screen!

We are so excited to get Wandering Sword's demo into your hands and hear your feedback - good or bad. It would help you get a glimpse of our vision and help us understand what you like or dislike about the game at this point. These would go a long way in helping us shape Wandering Sword into the great game we envision it to be.

So yeah! Right now, we are all hands on deck preparing a solid demo for Steam Next Fest. In addition, we will be increasing our post frequency to cover not just game updates, but also share more about the backstory and culture that led us to create Wandering Sword. 

Last but not the least, the team at Wandering Sword would like to take this opportunity to wish everyone a Happy New Year! May 2023 be a better year for everyone!
